758:t_1:492.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...The $$ジオン共和国$$ will be dissolved today, and $$ジオン$$ as a nation will cease to exist completely...」

758:t_1:493.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$ジオン$$ will be reborn as a political organization. I wanted to share that moment with you.」

758:t_1:495.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I'm no longer $$ジオン$$'s princess. But I'm sure there must be something I can do...」

758:t_1:496.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「To find it, I'm going to study under $$ハマーン$$.」

758:t_1:497.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We'll see each other again, won't we?」

758:t_1:498.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You came back to me. This time, I promise I'll come back to you.」

758:t_1:500.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$マリーダ$$... I'm no longer a princess.」

758:t_1:501.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You say that, but the whole $$ガランシェール$$ crew has found work as your bodyguards, $$ミネバ$$.」

758:t_1:502.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「So please allow me to accompany you.」

758:t_1:503.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Thank you, $$マリーダ$$ and $$ジンネマン$$.」

758:t_1:504.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$バナージ$$... You take care too.」

758:t_1:505.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'm sure the light you showed us will illuminate the world... I'm grateful to you.」

758:t_1:506.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Please take care of $$オードリー$$... of $$ミネバ$$, $$マリーダ$$.」

758:t_1:508.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We don't need to hide anything anymore. So let's accept everything and start our relationship over from the beginning.」

758:t_1:511.en:
$$バナージ$$
(I... may never pilot a $$ガンダム$$ again...)

758:t_1:512.en:
$$バナージ$$
(But that's all right. I'd like everyone in $c to see the future I choose from now on...)

758:t_1:513.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「It feels strange... To think we were fighting alongside her just the other day.」

758:t_1:514.en:
$$ミコット$$
「You could say the same about everyone in $c.」

758:t_1:515.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「You're right. ...But that's all in the past now.」

758:t_1:516.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「First, I'll graduate from school. I need to do that before I think about what comes next.」

758:t_1:517.en:
$$ミコット$$
「Let's all do our best, $$バナージ$$, you too.」

758:t_1:519.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Thank you, $$オードリー$$... It was only for a little while, but I'm glad I got to see you.」

758:t_1:520.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...The $$ジオン共和国$$ will be dissolved today, and $$ジオン$$ as a nation will cease to exist completely...」

758:t_1:521.en:

758:t_1:523.en:

758:t_1:524.en:

758:t_1:525.en:

758:t_1:526.en:

758:t_1:528.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$ジンネマン$$... I'm no longer a princess.」

758:t_1:529.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You say that, but the whole $$ガランシェール$$ crew has found work as your bodyguards, $$ミネバ$$.」

758:t_1:530.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「So please allow me to accompany you.」

758:t_1:532.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$バナージ$$... You take care too.」

758:t_1:533.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'm sure the light you and $$マリーダ$$ showed us will illuminate the world... That's why we can keep moving forward too.」

758:t_1:534.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Please take care of $$オードリー$$... of $$ミネバ$$, Captain.」

758:t_1:536.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We don't need to hide anything anymore. So let's accept everything and start our relationship over from the beginning.」

758:t_1:539.en:
$$バナージ$$
(I... may never pilot a $$ガンダム$$ again...)

758:t_1:540.en:
$$バナージ$$
(But that's all right. I'd like everyone in $c to see the future I choose from now on...)

758:t_1:544.en:
$$ラクス$$
「...Thank you, Representative $$アスハ$$. Our discussion today has been very productive.」

758:t_1:545.en:
$$カガリ$$
「I thank you as well, Councilor $$クライン$$. Let us both do our utmost for the world's future.」

758:t_1:547.en:
$$アスラン$$
「It looks like $$オーブ$$ will keep serving as a bridge between Earth and $$プラント$$ in this new world too.」

758:t_1:548.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「$$クロノ$$ has been destroyed, but the remnants of $$ブルーコスモス$$ it incited will probably remain a problem.」

758:t_1:549.en:
$$メイリン$$
「Are you saying they'll start another war?」

758:t_1:550.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「It's possible. We still don't know what the future holds for $$コーディネイター$$s.」

758:t_1:551.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「That doesn't give them the right to attack living people.」

758:t_1:552.en:
$$シン$$
「That's why we're here. We'll protect the world from people like that.」

758:t_1:554.en:
$$シン$$
「My fight is to put an end to war.」

758:t_1:555.en:
$$ステラ$$
「$$ステラ$$ will help too.」

758:t_1:557.en:
$$ムウ$$
「$$ステラ$$ no longer has any aftereffects from the mind control. She had plenty of rehabilitation in $$オーブ$$.」

758:t_1:558.en:
$$ムウ$$
「So, $$シン$$... please let $$ステラ$$ do what she wants.」

758:t_1:559.en:
$$シン$$
「...If that's the case, all right.」

758:t_1:560.en:
$$キラ$$
「You look after her too, $$ルナマリア$$.」

758:t_1:561.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Of course. I can handle one more handful besides $$シン$$.」

758:t_1:564.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Or will you throw a tantrum here and prove that you're a handful?」

758:t_1:565.en:
$$シン$$
「I won't do that. I consider myself fully capable now, too.」

758:t_1:566.en:
$$イザーク$$
「You've certainly learned to speak up.」

758:t_1:567.en:
$$ディアッカ$$
「Then prove it with your actions, not your words.」

758:t_1:568.en:
$$シン$$
「I'd be glad to. I intend to keep fighting to protect this hyperdimensional world.」

758:t_1:569.en:
$$キラ$$
「We feel the same way. Let's work together, $$シン$$, so we never forget what we learned in the multiverse... in $c.」

758:t_1:571.en:
$$シン$$
(We learned to live together, overcoming our sorrow, anger, and hatred...)

758:t_1:572.en:
$$シン$$
(That won't change in this new world. I'll keep fighting to protect it, together with my friends...)

758:t_1:573.en:
$$シン$$
(That's what I... gained from fighting alongside $$カミーユ$$ and everyone else.)
